changelog: **The click-to-call "Yes" says when it moved the lead (#3748 × #3746):** a "Did you reach them? Yes" on a first-stage lead goes through `POST /api/interactions`, so the first-contact rule could move it, but nothing on the page said so. `ContactActions` now reads the same `stageAdvance` answer the interaction form reads. It shows the same "moved to <stage>" toast with Undo, and the page (stage badge, interactions card) re-reads itself. The toast and Undo are one hook, `useStageAdvanceToast()`, shared by the form and the question; Undo moves the record back through `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]`, the board's stage write. With the setting off, the toast still says only that the contact was logged.

en: When a call from a lead's page moves the lead to the next stage, you now see it and can undo it.
tr: Lead sayfasından yapılan bir arama lead'i bir sonraki aşamaya taşıdığında artık bunu görüyor ve geri alabiliyorsunuz.
de: Wenn ein Anruf von der Lead-Seite den Lead in die nächste Phase verschiebt, sehen Sie das jetzt und können es rückgängig machen.
